reviews.text: This clinic really cares about the animals. We have had nothing but amazing experiences with all of the vets here. I reccomend them to everyone I know. We have had exceptional care for Liam & Luna from Dr Slack and Dr Yui.

I always take my pups here.

They receive excellent care. I don’t get pressured into expensive treatments and they always manage to squeeze me in when it’s an emergency.

Edit.

Over the years it’s just gotten more expensive. Even routine things like nail trims cost over 30 dollars. I jokingly said “maybe they are private equity and that’s why they are pushy with bloodwork” and sure enough. They are.

I had to shop around for another vet because I was priced out.

Still leaving some stars tho.

This was my first time at Heights Vet Clinic NW and it was a wonderful experience. I brought Timmy the Turtle in for an injury and I was very worried. But from check-in to the vet assistant to Dr Yu answering all of my (many) questions, everyone was friendly, knowledgeable, professional, caring, and empathetic. I felt so much better when I left, as did Timmy (they're much better now, BTW). I will recommend this clinic to every animal lover I know!

I brought my pet in a couple of weeks ago, and honestly, it was the best experience ever. I absolutely love Dr. Yu! She is so knowledgeable, caring, and genuinely takes the time to answer all of my questions. I really appreciate how comfortable she makes me feel and how much she clearly cares about the animals she treats.

The only thing I would say is that some of the receptionists and technicians could use a attitude adjustment. 😅 Other than that, as long as you’re okay with dealing with a good amount of an attitude during your visit, this is honestly the perfect place to go. Dr. Yu is amazing, and I would definitely recommend her!
Brought my baby girl here on a recommendation from my niece, and have now found my new vet. Recommended 100% great atmosphere and so welcoming!

I was recommended this place from a local vet clinic for my budgie who has an eye problem. I drove all the way down from Spring to see Dr. Yu because there are not a lot of avian vets in HTX. I must say, the professionalism, friendliness, and thoroughness she and her staff offered was so refreshing. You can tell they love animals and she was so knowledgeable on birds (not playing it off like other vets I've been to). The examination on the eye was not stressful on my Nugget at all. He left with me still chirping and talking like no big deal and we had a care regime with medicine. I will definitely be back for all my flock needs! (Also, this place did not cost an arm and a leg) 10/10

My baby had a very scary moment of pooping blood everywhere and the office was not yet open. We called anyway and they got us in before they were even open. They took amazing care of my baby girl, gave us regular updates and even helped us out with the price because we were struggling at the time. We just moved states and are sad we can’t bring our dog here any longer. Huge thanks to the staff here and their amazing support. Highly recommend to anyone in the area!

I brought my tortoise in for a wellness check and I was very impressed by the level of attention and service we received. The check in and out process was quick and easy, our technician Tung was very knowledgeable and patient, and Dr. Mai went above and beyond to make sure I left better informed on proper care.
Excellent 👌

We just love Heights Vet Clinic Northwest. We see Dr. Powers and have such a great experience every time. We have a rescue doodle that is reactive. The staff and Dr. Powers are so kind and patient every time we visit. And we never have any issues getting an appointment. They have specific fear free appointments meant for reactive pups where they allot more time to make sure it’s a calm, slow paced environment. I can’t recommend this clinic and Dr. Powers highly enough.

Had an awesome team to care for our pet cat who was not feeling well. They were caring and explained everything they were doing and what to expect during our visit and aftercare. I would def recommend and will return for following visits.
Overpriced and not at all helpful with a situation where I needed a script filled for one of my pets.  There are other clinics that are more reasonably priced and  more helpful!

There are not enough words to describe how wonderfully amazing the doctors and team are at Heights Vet. I have unfortunately been with them for 2 pets passing and cannot thank them enough for their care and compassion. Most recently, my pup was hospitalized for a week here, while trying to save him. They gave him the best care and set clear expectations for me, all while simply being a shoulder to cry on (literally) and an ear to listen. It’s been a few weeks since his passing, and I received the most beautiful card from the team in the mail. I want you all to know how much it meant to me. Thank you Heights Vet ❤️❤️
Great service and happy staff. A little pricey. Just make sure you ask them how much each test and medication will cost before they do it.

Be very aware they'll try to upcharge you for services that are not necessary upon initial consultation just to turn a larger profit.

Disgusting they prioritize money that much over helping animals.

Seriously don't understand how they're so highly rated. They tried to charge me over $900 because my dog had an upset tummy that was corrected in a few days with some meds.

INSANITY.
My sibling took in their Russian dwarf hamster. They were very thorough, informative, and incredibly friendly. You can tell they care deeply for animals. I definitely feel comfortable coming back!
Dr.Yu is hands down the best vet I’ve taken my dogs too! The entire team at Heights Veterinary Clinic is always kind and compassionate!

Friendly staff, short wait time. DR. Yu was great with our snake and not afraid to say she didn't know but looked for help.

Our Queen Tweety is on the mend. I would love to go back, but maybe next time not for an injury.
I love all the vets here. They will take good care of your baby!
Amazing atmosphere and staff.
🫶🏾🫶🏾 My baby loves it here. His vet is his favorite. I'm a bit jealous lol. Thanks Height Vet for taking care of my baby.
Always helpful.
Great techs and vets and front desk too! Unequivocal recommendation
Dr Slack is very friendly and makes it easy when visiting with my pup.  The rest of the staff is just as great and welcoming.
ALL the staff at this location were very very helpful informative and mostly caring and sympathetic!!! They were all such a blessing!!!! Thank you so much from Melodie n Twinkie Rodriguez

Brought my 13 year old lab in as new patient. Waiting room was spacious and calm when I arrived at 1:30 appointment. Exam rooms are spacious as well. All concerns were addressed, they were understanding and informative. We got biopsies, X-rays blood and stool testing and vaccinations along with addressing other concerns.  Prices were fair and staff was awesome.

My pups get incredible care here! We’ve seen Dr. Yu and Dr. Pena and several techs and everyone has been amazing with my dogs different dispositions, getting them the care they need and being very informative when it comes to treatment/care/payment!

I saw Dr. Jesse Powers and her technician Emory last week for some x-rays for my middle aged dog. He's very anxious in new places, especially vet clinics, and they were so sweet with him! He needed to be sedated for his procedure, and it went very well. He was awake and ready to go home with me after no time, and I got all the answers I needed for managing his arthritis. So grateful for their compassionate and gentle care of my nervous boy. Thank you!

Truly saddened by how I was treated today. I called the vet to get my cat some help for his asthma. I've had several appointments with Dr. Slack. She initially prescribed him some steroids that helped, but later advised me that he needed long-term treatment with an inhaler. The inhaler has not helped. He again has fits of wheezing.

I called today to schedule a follow-up appointment to discuss new options, but they refused to see him, because the receptionist heard him wheeze over the phone and felt it was emergent, and they don't have the resources to handle an emergency. These are fits he has from time to time.

Now I have to start this process over with a new vet because they wouldn't even take the time to assess his condition or even allow me to explain this as an episode and not an emergency. What he needs is a new care plan, not the ER.

They even went as far as to say his condition is my fault because I have not administered the medication as prescribed, when I picked up the prescription from them and had it filled elsewhere.

I haven't had a bad experience with them prior, but just know that if their initial care plan doesn't work, they may not care enough to assess your furry friend any further.

First thing first, my baby loves this place. He was not nervous and felt relaxed during his visit. The technician and doctor handled him very gentle and used food to comfort him. He even started purring during the exam, this has never happened before else where. The price is also very reasonable, they explain you what’s needed and what’s not. We finally found a good place after moving to the heights. You can tell how relaxing he is on the exam table.🥰
Great people who truly care about your pet!
Love the vet super nice thank you
My german shepherd sees Dr. Yu. Vet provides excellent care.
They went above and beyond helping me with my passing cat which as most can imagine was worth more than any money could buy, even though it was relatively cheap. Angels work here.

Very organized business with friendly, kind, cheerful staff.  The vet, Dr. Albritton, took a great deal of time explaining my pup’s condition & the rationale for her treatment.

I can highly recommend this old Houston clinic.

I took my cats there for healthcare 30 yrs. ago.  That tells you something!

Five high-five paws for Dr. Albritton & her staff.

My guinea pig Stephanie had her first vet visit yesterday. So of course I was very nervous when I brought her in. To my surprise she was treated with so much love and compassion. She felt comfortable enough to be held right away. She allowed the doctor to examine her and she stayed calm during her nail trimming. I definitely was impressed and very happy with their service. I am happy to now have a doctor that will care for my baby.

Since moving into this area I have taken my pets to Heights Veterinary Clinic Northwest 2 or 3 times I always had a pleasant experience until today. I called for an appointment saying that my dog I thought had a sticker burr between her toes and asked for a same-day appointment. I got a call back and was told I would need to bring my pet in and leave her and the doctor could look at her around lunch time and I could pick her up later in the day. Subsequent to that I got a call I guess from the billing person who told me that the doctor wanted a estimate generated for charges that I would incur to make sure that I'm going to be okay with them and that was followed up with an email of estimated charges.

I have had dogs my entire life and have made many visits to veterinary clinics. Usually my pet would be  examined and then I would be presented with an estimate of recommended services for me to agree to. I think that's pretty standard operating procedure.  For whatever reason today was different. Without even examining my little 18 lb Boston Terrier who  I said I think has a sticker burr between her toes, I was presented with an estimate for almost $700 which included sedation 3 X-rays and a radiology consultation as if my pet had been hit by a car. It was mind-boggling! Where did they come up with these charges without ever doing an exam?  It gave the impression that either they felt like I couldn't afford to walk through the door of their clinic, which I said I had been to two or three times in the past and had always paid my bill when presented, or that they planned on billing high cost and totally unnecessary services and wanted to make sure I would fall for that. Either way, it's very shady!

I will not be back to Heights Veterinary Clinic.

Edit: just wanted to add what a great doctor dr slack is and what a great group of people work here. They have been providing amazing care to my pup for a couple of years now and I can’t recommend dr. Slack enough.
Great doctors and great vet techs. Always make time for me and my pup. I tend to be a very nervous dog mom as my pup can be a bit of a .... Rude boy. Dr slack and all the others there always try to make my pups visit positive and enjoyable!

I just want to sincerely thank the clinic, and especially Dr. Pina, for all the support and the prompt attention we received when we brought in my little dog for evaluation. Even though the final diagnosis was not favorable, they guided us through the process with compassion and humanity as we said goodbye to our beloved pet. The gesture of sending us a condolence letter only reaffirmed to me that this is a truly caring veterinarian who genuinely cares about you and your pet. Without a doubt, I will return when I have a new pet. Thank you.

The staff was helpful over the phone with advice on how to best help the stray and how to protect our other cat.  We were seen promptly upon arrival, the place was clean and welcoming.   I sometimes get overwhelmed by the allergens at our other vet, so this was a surprise feature.
By far my favorite Vet Clinic to take my pets to.
Staff was very nice and handled my German Shepherd very well. Was able to get an appointment same day and fairly priced exam fee.
Once again, Dr Yiu is the best.

Very attentive staff from reception to the physicians.  I love that they didn't push for the most expensive  diagnostics and treatments. They could see our genuine concern for our baby and responded accordingly.  Jack is doing MUCH better. Thank you.
-Jack Sparrow Family-
Caring, friendly, thorough & professional staff. They really love what they do!
First experience was great. The staff took time to understand what I wanted and didn’t push any additional services that were not absolutely necessary.
I trust no other place with my fur baby!  Honest, Caring, Professional.

This clinic has significantly declined. While the staff is friendly, the costs are exorbitant. On my first visit with a rescued stray cat, I paid $200+  for a basic checkup and vaccinations, I had no problem paying until realizing they are charging more than most clinics. A few days later, a lump appeared on the cat’s leg, possibly related to the initial treatment. When I called to have the issue addressed they were very accommodating and took us in right away, until I was quoted $248 just for an examination and medications we didn’t know we needed yet. After some discussion, the fee was reduced to $67, but at the point this still felt unreasonable for a problem likely tied to their prior care, I was just looking for a quick inspection to see if it was related or not, they wouldn’t do that without my commitment to pay.

Additionally, their neutering prices are double those of most clinics in the area. If affordability and transparency matter to you, I recommend looking elsewhere. . It’s unfortunate to see a once-great clinic focus more on profits than care.

They were so sweet to my 2 cats Jackson and Marshall, I got Jackson fixed here and his kitten shots. I appreciated the staffs patience with me, I arrived very early for my appointment, because I miscalculated my timing lol and they gladly put me in a room to wait instead of waiting in the waiting room or in my car with my stressed out cats. Once inside my cats acted as if they were at home! Lol but in the car they were acting wild. The staff made them feel extra comfortable and welcomed. The pricing is about average.
We love and trust all the amazing staff! Very friendly and caring vet office!
Dr. Yu and her team are very caring, considerate, and thorough. I brought a pocket pet here and they took excellent care of him and took time to learn about his diagnosis and care.
No walk in service. Previous reviews are wrong.
Great and caring staff who truly knows what they're talking about!

Wonderful clinic. The staff are all so sweet and the vets excellent!  We have a very quirky English Mastiff and they know exactly how to deal with him and put him at ease.  They are very reasonable on pricing .  Highly recommend.

I have nothing but great things to say about my two visits to HVC so far. My young male Labrador had a terrible UTI that instead of running its course with the antibiotics from the ER vet decided to return with a vengeance. I was already casually shopping for a new primary care vet as I didn’t love the offices I had tried for various wellchecks for both my dog(s) and training clients.

While at VEG I had asked a vet tech there who she personally recommended and this was one of the two options which by happenstance had an open same day appointment when my dog became incredibly symptomatic and uncomfortable overnight a few days after finishing his antibiotics.

We have seen Jung as our vet tech and Dr Slack as our vet for both the initial appointment and the follow up we had today. Both allowed me to utilize the handling drills we have been working on since he was 8 weeks old because while he is incredibly social with zero behavior issues, he is a 7mo giant Labrador who is happy to body slam into anyone who he deems to be his friend if they start in with baby talk voice. Which I would rather not allow him to practice, so I am incredibly appreciative of these two being patient and afford Ghost the opportunity to practice good vet behaviors that we want as he grows up and gets even bigger.

Dr Slack had great attention to detail to the timeline I presented ant the first app
and my concerns about the bacterial skin rash that also seemed to be off and on brewing on his stomach. With this in mind we decided to go with a longer course of a different antibiotic that let us address the rash at the same time as the UTI. I was also provided with anti inflammatories and pain medication as needed for his first 2-3 days of starting treatment since he was not having a good time existing and this gave us relief until the abx kicked in full force.

We just finished our two week check up where they took another sterile urine sample and verified that the UTI was completely resolved. Dr Slack also took the time to talk through a medicated shampoo plan to deal with the remaining skin concerns and how to then taper him off of needing medicated baths to not turn into a cycle of treating and overdrying, which I greatly appreciate.

Overall 10/10, already recommending to others:
- quiet office
- quick moving to an exam room
- staffing that allowed young dog learning/training opportunities versus overwhelming with baby talk and too much affection for a bouncy wrecking ball of a Labrador
- great attention to detail and patience
- and honestly, REALLY affordable exam fees

Thank you a million times

- Kennedy and Ghost
Houston DogWorks
They are awesome and take great care of our pittys canela and sage
I have been taking my pets to Heights Vet Clinic for years and have been very pleased with their services.  Highly recommend.
